request.style: English, Soul, male baritone solo with gospel choir, Hammond organ, acoustic guitar, bass, drums, warm and reverent, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sons of Merari, Mahli and Mushi stood
Founders of the clan, by the Lord understood
In the wilderness camp, behind the holy tent
The Mahlites prepared where the covenant went

[Chorus]
Carrying the frames, the posts and the bases too
The ropes and the pegs, the work assigned to you
From thirty to fifty, strong for the task
Serving the sanctuary, the sacred place

[Verse]
The census was taken, every male named
Recorded in Numbers, in history claimed
Eleazar and Kish, the lineage flowed on
In David's temple, the service was done

[Chorus]
Carrying the frames, the posts and the bases too
The ropes and the pegs, the work assigned to you
From thirty to fifty, strong for the task
Serving the sanctuary, the sacred place

[Bridge]
No sons remained, but cousins took hold
Married the daughters, the story is told
The Mashites joined, the line kept intact
Faithful in service, standing firm

[Chorus]
Carrying the frames, the posts and the bases too
The ropes and the pegs, the work assigned to you
From thirty to fifty, strong for the task
Serving the sanctuary, the sacred place

[Outro]
Mahli, son of Merari, Levi's line
Preserved the tabernacle, holy and divine
